occasion: A smoke test of the trigram lesson acted out in Blender (blender/trigram.py): water over the lake, the lake filling to its rim and stopping, in place of the 2D trigrams. The series short is left alone.

caption.text: A lake holds only so much water, and that’s what makes it a lake. Limits work; harsh limits break.

lesson.text:
A lake holds only
so much water.
